description: This file defines the interface for Hands Free Profile (HFP) handling in Bluetooth, including enums, callback structures, and function prototypes for registration and command sending.

methods.name: bt_hfp_hf_register
methods.description: Registers the Handsfree profile callbacks to monitor connection state and details.
